title: The Franklinn- Room with a View (hot tub opt)
description:
2nd fl bedroom in huge farmhouse. Has queen bed, couch, desk. Shares bathroom with bedroom #5. Rural paradise with abundant wildlife (deer, turkey, bobcat, red-tail hawk, osprey, fox, hedgehog) in the protected Big East Fork Valley watershed.
Shared space include front and back porches with rockers, kitchen, living room (with TV),  dining room, and forest/meadow views. Adjacent to horse barn. Outside hot tub ($50 set up fee). Minutes from Lake Gratitude. Hiking trails from your door

host_details:
We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.

We look forward to your stay
